blind.description: A single wooden door leaf built from vertical dark-brown timber planks with a peaked/pointed arched top. It is reinforced on both sides with three horizontal dark iron strap bands studded with rounded rivets/bolts. A heavy round iron pull ring handle and keyhole lock plate are mounted on one side near the middle band. The wood has mossy/weathered greenish staining near the bottom edge. All geometry is solid, continuous, and clean, standing upright directly on its flat bottom edge without an added base plinth.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangular bar showing the segmented profile of vertical planks, flanked by small protruding rounded rivet heads and a circular door handle ring projecting from one face.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder-to-neck height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3.0 feet wide.
